title: Contador(A) Para Atendimento Ao Cliente
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contador(A) Para Atendimento Ao Cliente em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer. Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente. Conheça mais em: O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Ficar com o cliente até o fim. Você atende uma carteira de clientes e conduz cada caso até a resolução. Se precisar de apoio técnico do time interno, você aciona o time e permanece responsável pelo cliente. Entregar o Estudo Ada, o diagnóstico contábil da empresa do cliente. Você analisa o caso do cliente, aponta o que precisa ser feito e define as ações com prazos. O cliente sabe que você cuidou da empresa dele. Atender por videochamada. Você terá seu calendário de reunião e entra na conversa preparado para ajudar o cliente. Na prática, isso significa: Atender na linha de frente: WhatsApp, e-mail e chat da plataforma Ler o histórico do cliente antes de responder Conduzir o chamado do início ao fim, dentro do SLA, e confirmar com o cliente que resolveu Chamar reunião quando o caso pede conversa em vez de texto Orientar o cliente na plataforma e mostrar o que ela resolve por ele Avisar o time no primeiro sinal de que o cliente quer sair Anotar as particularidades e os pontos de atenção de cada cliente, para o próximo atendimento já começar com contexto Identificar problema que se repete e abrir ticket estruturado para engenharia O QUE A GENTE PROCURA CRC ativo Experiência em fiscal, contábil, legalização ou abertura de empresas Experiência em cuidar de uma carteira de clientes, e não só de uma fila de chamados Comunicação clara, direta e empática, no texto e em reuniões Conforto com número, volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e satisfação do cliente fazem parte do seu dia Autonomia para organizar o próprio trabalho no remoto Calma para atender cliente irritado e ainda sair com o problema resolvido DIFERENCIAIS Repertório de ferramentas de atendimento: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Zendesk ou similares Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda Interesse real por tecnologia e produto. Você quer entender como funciona o que está atendendo NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas. Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você! title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement - Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing - Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption. Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Arquitetura Azure

Implementar o ZeroLayer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura. Requisitos Obrigatórios Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos. Desejável: Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas células Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes. title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are: Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform. Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We’re Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Fincrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fincrime Analyst - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime. We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience. To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.G., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures What you'll need A bachelor's degree or equivalent Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)2+ years of FinCrime experience Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends Critical thinking skills Impeccable attention to detail The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure Nice to have A degree in law or STEM subject A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS) Fluency in other languages Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. - Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. automated root-cause analysis;

- Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.
- Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions.
- Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.
- Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: - Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:- Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
- Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

- Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
- Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
- Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).

title: Operations Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Lead em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About PerkUp PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.Com. We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution. This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated. The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction. This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule. What you’ll own Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations. Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability. Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy. Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability. Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution. Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems;
gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix. Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls. Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement. What success looks like Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably. Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors. Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence. PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement. What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes. Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams. Excellent written and spoken English;
full professional fluency is required. Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams. Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output. A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure. Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth. Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking. Role details Location: Remote, Latin America Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time Engagement: Full-time contractor $4,500–$5,000 USD per month Growth path This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data. Position Overview As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report. What You’ll Do Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization. Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity. Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data. Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.). Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses. Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows. Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights. Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor. Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels. Who You Are 2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills. Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data. Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor. Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis. Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership Excellent written and spoken English;
can explain technical findings to non-technical teams. Strong documentation habits. Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative. Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:

About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:

Senior Business Analyst Role Overview The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers. The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals. The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members. Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned. Job Specifications Education and Experience Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment. Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience. Skills and Abilities Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables. Technical Expectations The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist. Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED! The World's Most Driven Remote Operations Specialist About Chore Chore exists to kill admin so founders can\ "Chore No More\" and build their dreams. We are the end of admin. We are the future. We are the better world for everyone. We exist to make every startup in the world successful. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning. Check out more of what we do here: The Role We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists - the main conduit through which all of our clients' back-office operations run, including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance. As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship - you own the operations. In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on. These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless - and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first. Some Examples Of The Work We Do Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness - “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?” Work that gets genuinely strategic - e.G., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients. Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases. An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind. Our clients are early-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget - not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to. Contributing to our knowledge base. Internal, client-facing, and public-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice - and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice. Internal projects that make Chore stronger. SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements - scoped, executed and delivered by you. One note on scope: unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go-to-market, analytics or partnerships. What We're Looking For Required 3+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties. This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's. Strongly preferred HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience (We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background) And you're probably a fit if… You're a total geek for better processes - more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. Ticking items off your list while thinking\ "how could I do this more efficiently?\ " brings a smile to your face. There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter - you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries You're smart, detail-oriented, a natural context-switcher, with GREAT communication skills You have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by people - going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically You're open to giving and receiving feedback, up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method You start solving before you start asking. When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup - dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the\ "startup plumber\" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2+ years). This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth - but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months Nice to have, not required An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early-stage startup finance Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite Why This Role Is Special You will run real companies behind the scenes. Very few roles give you this much impact this early You get ownership from day one. From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies - not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility You get rare visibility. You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this You work with sharp, ambitious teammates who care deeply about doing things well You will grow faster than you imagined - start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs Compensation & Logistics Compensation. We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses of up to 30% based on performance. India - $12K USD/year Nigeria / Africa - $10.4K USD/year LATAM - $13K USD/year Note : we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics. Equity. All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure. Benefits (all eligible after you complete the 60-day probation period) Up to $250/month WFH stipend Up to $50/month wellness stipend Location. We're remote-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours. Schedule. US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit. Read Before Applying We believe in being upfront about the hard parts. US hours are required and can be demanding. This may not be suitable for everyone Remote work has real challenges. You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace High ambiguity. You must create structure, not wait for it Extreme context-switching. You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time Feedback fluency. You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways High ownership. Minimal hand-holding. You are expected to self-manage Client-facing pressure. Founders move fast and expect clarity 60-day fully paid probation period. We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates. If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit. ❤️ Our Values Delight All Stakeholders. Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself Meritocracy. We reward value created - not longevity Experiment & Adapt. Try things, learn fast, improve continuously Assume Good Intentions. Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY) Please read this section carefully - following the instructions is part of how we assess applications. Your application has two parts. Both are required. Step 1 - Record a short video Record one video, no longer than 3 minutes, answering these two questions: 1. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?2. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own - not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved. A few notes: Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred) We're not judging production quality - we want to hear how you think We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please. Step 2 - Submit the application form (Only once your video is recorded) Form: When sharing your resume, please name as follows: Firstname.Lastname.OS - Resume - for example, Jane.Doe.OS - Resume. PDF preferred. What Happens Next We move quickly, and we'd rather you know exactly what's coming: We review your application and video - usually within a week A 30-minute screening call, so we can get to know you A paid case study - 1 to 2 hours of work, with 72 hours to complete it. You'll receive a payment for your time Four interviews, to meet different team members including a Chief Chore Officer (30 mins), a current Operations Specialist (30 mins), our head of Client Operations (30 mins) and finally our CEO (15 mins) Offer rollout We aim to go from application to decision in around three weeks.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Risk (Crypto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Fincrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fincrime Analyst - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime. We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience. To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.G., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures What you'll need A bachelor's degree or equivalent Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)2+ years of FinCrime experience Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends Critical thinking skills Impeccable attention to detail The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure Nice to have A degree in law or STEM subject A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS) Fluency in other languages Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: English Teacher

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
