title: Operations Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About PerkUp PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.Com. We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution. This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated. The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction. This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule. What you’ll own Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations. Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability. Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy. Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability. Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution. Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems;
gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix. Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls. Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement. What success looks like Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably. Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors. Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence. PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement. What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes. Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams. Excellent written and spoken English;
full professional fluency is required. Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams. Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output. A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure. Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth. Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking. Role details Location: Remote, Latin America Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time Engagement: Full-time contractor $4,500–$5,000 USD per month Growth path This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Writer (Brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads. Key Responsibilities 1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Cloud Architect
description:

Position: Azure Cloud Architect Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone) Contract: 6 month+ extensions This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone. You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy. Day to day, you will: Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability. Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t. Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start. Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements. Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies. Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security. Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale. Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time. Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them. Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly. Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams. Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change. Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards. Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS. Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions. Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams. Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles. Required Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent. 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations. 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture. Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services. Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.G., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution. Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM. Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design. Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal. Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend. Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment. Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs. Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS. How you work Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions. Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

title: Business Analyst / Pmo

Senior Business Analyst Role Overview The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers. The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals. The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members. Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned. Job Specifications Education and Experience Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment. Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience. Skills and Abilities Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables. Technical Expectations The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist. Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

Trata-se de uma posição de parceria comercial, e não de vínculo empregatício, o que pressupõe maturidade comercial para conduzir prospecção, negociação e fechamento com total liberdade de método e horário.O trabalho é realizado de forma 100% remota, sendo possível ao(à) representante realizar visitas presenciais pontuais quando necessário ao avanço de negociações.O profissional também atuará em interlocução direta com a liderança da empresa, incluindo diretores C-level com diagnóstico de Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA) e Altas Habilidades ou Superdotação (AHSD), em um ambiente que valoriza a comunicação transparente, os feedbacks técnicos objetivos e a comunicação direta. - Também atuará no atendimento e na conversão de leads inbound já gerados pela empresa;

- O candidato deve possuir domínio autônomo do RD Station, plataforma de CRM utilizada pela empresa;
- Espera-se capacidade de vender de forma inteiramente autônoma, sem depender de controle externo de agenda ou rotina;
- É essencial ter excelente comunicação e capacidade de conduzir negociações complexas;
- O profissional deve ter disponibilidade para realizar visitas comerciais pontuais, quando necessário ao avanço da negociação. Diferenciais que valorizamos- Experiência prévia em representação comercial ou em vendas para holdings e grupos empresariais;
- Vivência em vendas deserviços contábeis, consultoria ou negócios B2B recorrentes;
- Uso de ferramentas deinteligência artificial aplicadas à prospecção e à produtividade comercial;
- Repertório em comunicação com perfis neurodivergentes. Modelo de parceria comercial- Haverá reembolso de despesas com deslocamento e visitas comerciais, mediante comprovação, limitado a até R$ 2.000,00 mensais, quando aplicável;

A comprovação de falsidade de informações relevantes poderá resultar na eliminação do processo seletivo ou, em caso de contratação, na rescisão do contrato por justa causa contratual;
- As inscrições deverãoser realizadas exclusivamente pelo, por meio do botão de candidatura desta vaga. Candidaturas recebidas por e-mail ou qualquer outro canal não serão consideradas;
- Os prazos definidos emcada etapa do processo seletivo são fixos e imparciais para todos os candidatos, sem exceções ou flexibilizações, sendo a pontualidade um critério eliminatório.✨ Gostou da vaga? #PartiuDreamTeamSe você vende com autonomia, possui repertório comercial consistente e deseja representar marcas premiadas com potencial real de crescimento financeiro, será um prazer conhecer sua trajetória.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Regulatory & Corporate Governance Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Forte capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas, prazos e stakeholders ao mesmo tempo. title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data. Position Overview As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report. What You’ll Do Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization. Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity. Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data. Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.). Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses. Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows. Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights. Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor. Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels. Who You Are 2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills. Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data. Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor. Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis. Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership Excellent written and spoken English;
can explain technical findings to non-technical teams. Strong documentation habits. Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative. Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous. Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management. Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication. Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment. Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.

Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura. Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design. Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal. Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend. Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment. Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs. Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS. How you work Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Risk (Crypto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Supervisor de Qualidade
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supervisor de Qualidade em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Venha fazer parte do time da Ouro do Brasil, maior rede de joalherias do Norte e Nordeste! Com 16 anos de história, nos consolidamos como a empresa mais bem avaliada por seus clientes Por aqui somos especialistas em compra e venda de joias de ouro e relógios.
Aqui você encontra um ambiente que contempla diversidade, repleto de desafios e com muitas oportunidades de crescimento.

Se você se considera uma pessoa movida a desafios, com vontade de crescer, gosta de atuar como dono do negócio e é movido por resultados e entregas de qualidade, já tem meio caminho andado.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa talentosa, para somar ao nosso time de Pocessos, na função de Analista de Qualidade.

Atribuições do Cargo

  • Mapear, desenhar e padronizar processos operacionais das lojas, oficina e áreas administrativas
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria
  • Implantar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), especialmente relacionados a vendas, produtividade e qualidade
  • Estruturar e acompanhar metas comerciais em conjunto com gestores e lideranças
  • Criar fluxos operacionais claros e padronizados para as unidades
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais com análises de desempenho
  • Apoiar a liderança na tomada de decisão baseada em dados
  • Atuar na melhoria da experiência do cliente nas lojas
  • Acompanhar rotinas operacionais e garantir aderência aos processos definidos
  • Propor e conduzir projetos de melhoria contínua
  • Apoiar iniciativas de premiação e campanhas comerciais com base em indicadores
  • Integrar informações entre áreas (Lojas, Monitoramento, RH, Auditoria e Compliance)

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia de Produção, Gestão de Processos ou áreas correlatas (em andamento ou concluído)
  • Pós-Graduação, MBA na área de atuação (em andamento ou concluído)
  • Experiência anterior como Analista de Qualidade, Processos, Operações ou áreas similares
  • Vivência com implantação ou melhoria de processos
  • Experiência com indicadores de desempenho e metas
  • Atuação em ambientes operacionais ou comerciais
  • Experiência com projetos de melhoria contínua
  • Experiências em ferramentas e banco de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em comércio gestão operacional e comercial
  • Experiência em projetos e fluxos de negócios, controle operacional, indicadores de qualidade e auditoria de processos.
  • Experiência em Banco de Dados (Power BI / Excel); Processo (Bizagi / Fluxo) e Resultado (Metas / Indicadores)

Procuramos auxiliares de cozinha profissionais, rápidos e com experiência na área gastronômica para completar a nossa equipe de cozinha, seguindo as especificações e diretrizes dos nossos sous chefs e Chefs Executivos.                Manter todas as superfícies de trabalho da cozinha (balcões, pias, fornos, paredes) limpas e higienizadas;

               Limpeza e organização das praças;

               Reposição de produtos no começo e final do expediente;

               Manipulação e preparo de insumos, quando e conforme solicitado;

               Manter uma abordagem positiva e profissional com colegas e clientes;

               Sinalização para a liderança caso ativos da empresa precisem de manutenção.

Requisitos

               Ser um aprendiz rápido e com interesse no trabalho da cozinha;

               Conhecimento básico dos métodos culinários, ingredientes, equipamentos e procedimentos de cozinha;

               Capacidade de permanecer em pé por longos períodos;

               Disponibilidade para cumprir as normas de saúde e segurança;

               Boas habilidades organizacionais;

               Capacidade de trabalhar sem supervisão em um ambiente movimentado

               É desejável ter experiência anterior na cozinha de restaurantes

               É desejável ter ensino médio completo;

Habilidades e Skills

               Precisão e rapidez ao executar suas tarefas;

               Comunicação: Capacidade de comunicar claramente com a equipe de cozinha e manter um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo;

               Execução: Capacidade em ouvir comandos e executá-los com precisão e rapidez

               Organização: Ter senso de organização, ordem e limpeza;

               Disposição: Ter vontade e disposição física para o serviço;

               Inteligência emocional: compreender as próprias emoções e as emoções dos outros para construir relacionamentos, resolver conflitos, compreender as necessidades dos colegas e clientes;

               Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças de última hora, ajustar-se a novas situações e resolver problemas de forma criativa;

SOBRE A REDE BAHIA.

Somos 16 veículos multimeios com estratégia centrada no povo baiano.

Juntos descobrimos todos os dias como a comunicação pode mudar a vida de milhões de pessoas. Produzimos conteúdos regionalizados, com informação e entretenimento, conhecendo e respeitando o público baiano em seus interesses, culturas e hábitos. Tudo ao mesmo tempo, em diversas plataformas, mas também pessoalmente, com olho no olho e foco no que realmente interessa: os baianos.

Por isso, a Rede Bahia não para! Porque quem nos move são vocês. Qual novidade vamos colocar no ar hoje?

A Rede Bahia é o maior grupo de mídia e conteúdo do Norte e Nordeste do Brasil com atuação em quatro áreas: Televisão, Rádio, Digital e Eventos.

Junto nossos negócios levam entretenimento, cultura e informação para mais de 12 milhões de pessoas. Primeiro e único de emissora de TV aberta a cobrir todo o Estado.

NOSSA CULTURA.

Empoderamos pessoas e comunidades por meio de conteúdo e notícias que nutrem e movimentam toda a sociedade.

Compartilhamos vínculos culturais. Descobrimos e criamos juntos ideias para rir, pensar e viver experiências.

Nossa plataforma multimeios contempla o interesse e a necessidade de nosso do público por meio de uma rede integrada de canais que investe em tecnologia de ponta e equipe humana de alta

performance.

Acreditamos que a pluralidade de vozes, histórias e vivências transforma não só a forma como comunicamos, mas também como construímos um ambiente de trabalho mais justo, representativo e inovador.

Buscamos pessoas com diferentes trajetórias, histórias e perspectivas, pois acreditamos que a pluralidade fortalece nosso propósito e amplia nosso olhar.
